page.overview:
Who is Abe Crane?

At Rook Control, Abe Crane assigned various agents (or knights) for different assignments. He personally hand-picked former treasury agent and special forces operative Roger Dayton to become a knight for a mission involving stolen printing plates.

Crane instructed Dayton to track down a group of counterfeiters who had been using government plates and destroy their operation. Dayton only partially succeeded on the mission and Crane admonished him for his lack of delicacy.
